# kick-off

Turn the owner's intent into merged work: one manager per project routes it, workers define and do it.

Arguments: worker replay-worker manager replay-manager task 1168, Keep concurrent files-board writes

## Route

`Read` [references/protocol.md](references/protocol.md), then the playbook of the first row that fits.

| arguments | role | playbook |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `worker <name> manager <manager>`, then a url or the owner's words | worker | [references/worker.md](references/worker.md) |
| `sentinel <name> manager <manager>`, then a duty's words or url | sentinel | [references/sentinel.md](references/sentinel.md) |
| `succeed <name>` | manager | [references/manager.md](references/manager.md)'s Succession |
| anything else | manager | [references/manager.md](references/manager.md) |

Do each operation they name as [references/adapters.md](references/adapters.md) says for the adapter in use.

**Write it right once**: a board write passes its text as a file written first by the Write tool, never a bare `cat >` in a chained call, which waits on stdin until the call times out, and carries a title of at most 40 characters, since a hook denies the call otherwise and nothing runs.

**Stay in your worktree**: a worker never starts a command with `cd` into the live checkout, since a hook denies it; read that checkout by path or `git -C`.

2	`body.md` and `comments/<k>.md`, oldest first. Every record is trusted, since only local users write the folder."""
3	import json
4	import os
5	import pathlib
6	import re
7	import shlex
8	from datetime import datetime, timezone
9	
10	import claude_config
11	import data_folder
12	import team_settings
13	import team_signal
14	
15	
16	def default_folder():
17	    """The main checkout's `.teamwork/board`, the same for every worktree of a project and never committed; outside a repository, or with no git, the Claude config folder's."""
18	    return data_folder.folder("board") or claude_config.folder() / "teamwork" / "board"
19	
20	FOLDER = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("TEAMWORK_BOARD_DIR") or default_folder())
21	USE = re.compile(r"use-board\.py\s+(file|comment|decide|edit|title|resolve|reopen|order|nest|label)\b([^;&|\n]*)")
22	POSTED = re.compile(r"file://\S*?/(\d+)(?:#comment-(\d+))?(?=[\s\"\\]|$)")
23	trusted = lambda record: True
24	
25	def stamp(seconds=None):
26	    return datetime.fromtimestamp(seconds or datetime.now().timestamp(), timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
27	
28	def numbers():
29	    return sorted(int(path.name) for path in FOLDER.glob("[0-9]*"))
30	
31	def meta(number):
32	    return json.loads((FOLDER / str(number) / "issue.json").read_text())
33	
34	def save(number, **change):
35	    """Writes NUMBER's changed fields, then touches the signal file, which a GitHub write gets from the issue pane."""
36	    old = meta(number) if change.get("createdAt") is None else {}  # a change to a missing issue raises, never makes the folder
37	    (FOLDER / str(number) / "issue.json").write_text(json.dumps({**old, **change, "updatedAt": stamp()}))
38	    team_signal.SIGNAL.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
39	    team_signal.SIGNAL.touch()
40	
41	def record(number, comments=True):
42	    issue, folder = meta(number), FOLDER / str(number)
43	    notes = [{"body": path.read_text(), "url": f"file://{folder}#comment-{int(path.stem)}", "createdAt": stamp(path.stat().st_mtime), "trusted": True}
44	             for path in sorted((folder / "comments").glob("*.md"))] if comments else []
45	    return {"number": number, "title": issue["title"], "body": (folder / "body.md").read_text(), "url": f"file://{folder}", "state": issue["state"], "stateReason": issue["reason"],
46	            "createdAt": issue["createdAt"], "closedAt": issue["closedAt"], "trusted": True, "labels": issue["labels"], "parent": issue["parent"], "isPullRequest": False,
47	            "mergedAt": None, "comments": notes}
48	
49	def scoped(project):
50	    label = team_settings.load(os.getcwd())["scope_prefix"] + project
51	    return label if any(label in meta(number)["labels"] for number in numbers()) else None
52	
53	def issues(state="open", project=None, pulls=False, comments=True, since=None, repo=None):
54	    """The issues newest first, those labelled `scope:<project>` when that label exists, updated since SINCE (an ISO time) when given."""
55	    label = project and scoped(project)
56	    keep = lambda issue: state in ("all", issue["state"].lower()) and (not label or label in issue["labels"]) and (not since or issue["updatedAt"] >= since)
57	    return [record(number, comments) for number in reversed(numbers()) if keep(meta(number))]
58	
59	def fresh(number, repo=None, comments=True):
60	    try:
61	        return record(int(number), comments)
62	    except (OSError, ValueError):
63	        return None
64	
65	def comments_since(since):
66	    return [(number, note) for number in numbers() for note in record(number)["comments"] if note["createdAt"] >= since]
67	
68	def changed_since(stamp):
69	    return any(meta(number)["updatedAt"] >= stamp for number in numbers())
70	
71	def blockers(number):
72	    return [blocker for blocker in meta(number)["blockers"] if meta(blocker)["state"] == "OPEN"]
73	
74	def tree(project, nodes=None):
75	    """The open issues' nodes in the shape the issue pane draws, as GitHub's read gives them."""
76	    every = {number: meta(number) for number in numbers()}
77	    waits = lambda number: {"nodes": [{"number": blocker, "state": every[blocker]["state"]} for blocker in every[number]["blockers"]]}
78	    children = lambda number: [child for child, issue in every.items() if issue["parent"] == number]
79	    nodes = nodes if nodes is not None else [
80	        {**{k: issue[k] for k in ("number", "title", "url", "body")}, "parent": issue["parent"] and {"number": issue["parent"]}, "blockedBy": waits(issue["number"]),
81	         "labels": {"nodes": [{"name": name} for name in issue["labels"]]}, "comments": {"nodes": [{"body": note["body"], "url": note["url"]} for note in issue["comments"]]},
82	         "subIssuesSummary": {"total": len(children(issue["number"])), "completed": sum(every[child]["state"] == "CLOSED" for child in children(issue["number"]))},
83	         "subIssues": {"nodes": [{"number": child, "title": every[child]["title"], "url": f"file://{FOLDER}/{child}", "state": every[child]["state"], "stateReason": every[child]["reason"] or None, "blockedBy": waits(child)}
84	                                 for child in children(issue["number"])][-50:]}} for issue in reversed(issues("open", project))]
85	    for node in nodes:
86	        node["trusted"] = True
87	        for item in node["comments"]["nodes"] + (node.get("subIssues") or {}).get("nodes", []):
88	            item["trusted"] = True
89	    return nodes
90	
91	def comment(number, text):
92	    """Adds TEXT as NUMBER's next comment; its url."""
93	    meta(number)  # raises when NUMBER does not exist
94	    folder = FOLDER / str(number) / "comments"
95	    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
96	    position = len(list(folder.glob("*.md"))) + 1
97	    (folder / f"{position:04d}.md").write_text(text)
98	    save(number)
99	    return f"file://{FOLDER}/{number}#comment-{position}"
100	
101	def file(title, body, labels) -> int:
102	    number = max(numbers(), default=0) + 1
103	    (FOLDER / str(number)).mkdir(parents=True)
104	    save(number, title=title, labels=list(labels), state="OPEN", reason="", parent=None, blockers=[], createdAt=stamp(), closedAt=None)
105	    (FOLDER / str(number) / "body.md").write_text(body)
106	    return number
107	
108	def body(number):
109	    try:
110	        return (FOLDER / str(number) / "body.md").read_text()
111	    except OSError as e:
112	        raise LookupError(f"cannot read #{number} ({e.strerror}); check TEAMWORK_BOARD_DIR") from e
113	
114	def edit(number, text):
115	    body(number)
116	    (FOLDER / str(number) / "body.md").write_text(text)
117	    save(number)
118	
119	def resolve(number, summary, completed=True):
120	    comment(number, summary)
121	    save(number, state="CLOSED", reason="COMPLETED" if completed else "NOT_PLANNED", closedAt=stamp())
122	
123	def reopen(number):
124	    """Opens NUMBER again; an open one stays as it is, as GitHub leaves it."""
125	    if meta(number)["state"] == "CLOSED":
126	        save(number, state="OPEN", reason="REOPENED", closedAt=None)
127	
128	def retitle(number, title):
129	    save(number, title=title)
130	
131	# each refusal below is one GitHub answers with 422 or 404, so a files board accepts only what GitHub accepts
132	def order(later, earlier):
133	    meta(earlier)  # raises when it does not exist, before anything is written
134	    if int(later) == int(earlier) or int(earlier) in meta(later)["blockers"]:
135	        raise LookupError(f"#{later} already waits on #{earlier}, or is #{earlier}")
136	    save(later, blockers=sorted([*meta(later)["blockers"], int(earlier)]))
137	
138	def nest(backlog, task):
139	    meta(backlog)
140	    if int(backlog) == int(task) or meta(task)["parent"]:
141	        raise LookupError(f"#{task} already has a parent, or is #{backlog}")
142	    save(task, parent=int(backlog))
143	
144	def label(number, name, remove=False):
145	    labels = [existing for existing in meta(number)["labels"] if existing != name]
146	    if remove and len(labels) == len(meta(number)["labels"]):
147	        raise LookupError(f"#{number} has no label {name}")
148	    save(number, labels=labels if remove else [*labels, name])
149	
150	def command(text):
151	    """The `use-board.py` write TEXT runs, as the fields route-event reads; None when it runs none."""
152	    found = USE.search(text)
153	    if not found:
154	        return None
155	    verb, rest = found.groups()
156	    try:
157	        args = shlex.split(rest)
158	    except ValueError:
159	        args = []
160	    return {"called": f"use-board.py {verb}", "write": {"decide": "comment", "title": "edit"}.get(verb, verb if verb in ("file", "comment", "resolve", "edit") else None),
161	            "title": len(args[0]) if verb == "file" and args else len(args[1]) if verb == "title" and len(args) > 1 else None, "inline body": False, "body edit": False,
162	            "body file": args[1] if verb in ("file", "comment", "decide") and len(args) > 1 else None}
163	
164	def posted(output):
165	    """(url, body) of the first issue or comment url OUTPUT names, read back now; None when it names none."""
166	    found = POSTED.search(output)
167	    if not found:
168	        return None
169	    number, position = found.groups()
170	    path = FOLDER / number / "comments" / f"{int(position):04d}.md" if position else FOLDER / number / "body.md"
171	    return found.group(0), path.read_text() if path.exists() else ""
